_comment: Claims register for the education funding page. A student decides whether to apply, and when, on the strength of this.
pageTitle: How do I pay for school?

claims.claim: The Post-Secondary Student Support Program (PSSSP) funds First Nations post-secondary students.
Eligible costs can include tuition, books, travel support and living allowances.
claims.sourceQuote: Eligible costs covered by the program can include: tuition, books, travel support, living allowances

claims.claim: Students apply through their First Nation or a First Nations-designated organisation, which sets its own selection criteria, application process and deadlines.
claims.sourceQuote: First Nations or First Nations-designated organizations are responsible for determining the selection criteria for PSSSP funding

claims.claim: Funding is limited, not every student is funded, and partial funding may be given.
claims.sourceQuote: Funding is limited and not all students may be funded. Partial funding may be provided.
claims.note: The page must not imply an entitlement. Confirm the framing is honest without being discouraging — a student who assumes a refusal is final may not reapply.

claims.claim: Where a Nation's list is full there are other routes — bursaries, scholarships, and reapplying in a later intake.
claims.note: The page's practical advice for the most common outcome. Confirm it reflects what actually happens.
